definition: Affluent means wealthy — supplied with money so plentiful that it seems to flow in on its own.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word affluent. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know affluent should be able to work it out from your sentence.

Comfortable is weaker than affluent: a comfortable family covers every bill with a little left over, while an affluent one has money enough to stop thinking about the bills at all.
Opulent is stronger than affluent: affluent money quietly funds ease, but opulence spills into display — marble, gilt, and chandeliers meant to be seen.
